text.en:
In order to compensate the Mountain Province for the loss in revenue which it may suffer on
account of the abolition of the road tax, there is appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not
otherwise appropriated, the sum of eighty thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, to be
released by the Secretary of Finance, upon the approval of the President: Provided, That the amount so
released to carry out the purpose of this Act shall not exceed the average of the proceeds of the road tax
collected in the Mountain Province during the years nineteen hundred and thirty-six and nineteen hundred and
thirty-seven.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 22, 1938.
